updates.delegated.title: This copy does not update itself
updates.delegated.package_manager: It was installed by a package manager. Update it with the package manager.
updates.delegated.not_writable: It is installed in a location you cannot write to, so it cannot replace itself.
updates.delegated.unbundled: It is a bare binary outside an application bundle, such as a development run.
updates.delegated.development_build: It is a development build, which never updates itself.
updates.delegated.unsupported: Self-update is not supported on this operating system.
updates.error.title: The update did not complete
updates.error.unchanged: The version that is running was not changed.
updates.error.update_check_failed: The release list could not be read. Check the connection and try again.
updates.error.update_feed_unavailable: The release feed is not available: the release repository could not be found or is not readable without sign-in. No update was checked.
updates.error.update_checksum_missing: The release has no usable checksum for this download, so it was rejected.
updates.error.update_checksum_mismatch: The download does not match its checksum, so it was discarded.
updates.error.update_no_artifact: This release has no download for this system.
updates.error.update_install_failed: The new version could not be put in place.
updates.error.update_rollback_failed: The install failed and could not be undone cleanly. Reinstall CommitBrief UI from the release page if it misbehaves.
updates.error.update_delegated: This copy is updated by something else.
updates.error.update_nothing_to_install: There is no update to install. Check for updates first.
updates.error.update_busy: Another check or install is already running.
updates.error.internal: Something went wrong. Details are in the log.
